content: Andiiniŋ sokohi
Wa raakissa mbeh, Yeesu nikka ŋ sereendaŋ cookma, a jangɗoheeɗa. Mboolnda wilee ɗe laayya lool, po a mirndohha rap ŋ gaal, a ɓooffa nga ; a nikka ŋ masma, mboolnda nikka ŋ sereenda.
A jangɗeeɗa ɓa ŋ andiin inaa laayiɗ, a woosa ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ jangɗoha ne :
« Sikɗukaat ! A nikee guuroh, a kaɗta soka.
Wi a soke, a saaweeɗa tisohi, in nga hennda ŋ waasi ŋ ɗooƴ yohni, sel ci hayya ñammbaa.
Raakka ci keen ŋ ɗisik laayaaɗi merhey, raakiɗ atoh, tahha po ca arra paar,
waaye wi nohi dam, in ca paaree leeɓpa po ca onnja sagu ini ca raakeeɗi niir nooɗiɗ.
In ŋ tisohi nammba keen ŋ ɗisik raakiɗ ñaaɓaaɓ ; ca paarandoosa na ñaaɓaaɓ ca, ceem ndooƴca ca po ca raakɗi ali rim.
Waaye raakka ci keen ŋ keheƴ baahiɗ, ca paarra, ca yakka, ca rimmba, cum eɗohha rim ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay (30), cum ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino (60), cum teemet (100). »
Ƴutta, Yeesu woosa ɓa ne : « Ɓo' nu raak nof kerhoha ɗah, a kerhaat. »
Wa a saɓsukoh na mboolnda po a nikka na taalubeeci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci (12) na ɓooɓa meeɗ nik na ɗe, ɓa meekissa ɗe ini kaɗ ŋ andiin ceem.
A loffa ɓa ne : « Ɗu onuuɗ ne ɗu inah ini ɗasɗukiɗiŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh. Waaye ɓaahaaɗiici na rahse in ci jen ngaŋ andiin
ne

content.text: “ ɓa markee baahiɗ, ɓa minuu hot ;
ɓa sikɗukee baahiɗ, ɓa minuu inah.
po Kooh kee ɓa ɗaasa bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa. ” »

content: Yeesu woyissa ɓa ne : « Ɗu inahɗi ini andiinii tokis e ? Kon, ne ɗu inah ci tas jen wa hey miske nga ɗu !
Sokohi na soke woo kiŋ Kooh.
Ɓum ɓeɗ ŋ sero waasi, ɗiski Woo ki saawu ; ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe woo kiŋ Kooh, Seytaani jaar hay, nihisa nga ɓa.
Ɓum ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ kehƴi raak atoh ci ; ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe Woo ki, ɓa jaara teyɗuk na keeñ soosiɗ,
waaye ɓa na raakeeɗi niir ŋ haf ɓa, ɓa na maañeeɗi nga. Ɓa raak miskiɗ wala ɓa tolfiɗassee sagu Woo ki ɗah, ɓa ar faɗ.
Ɓum ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ ñaaɓaaɓ ci ; ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe Woo ki, ɓa teyɗuka,
waaye liiɓsiɗoh ci, na raak-raak ci na njuyohe, na waaɗ neɓiɗ ciŋ Adina, amb ɓa po Woo ki minuu rim ali in.
Ɓinooɓi ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ kehƴi baahiɗi ; ɓeɗ ɓi na kerhe Woo ki, ɓa teyɗuka. Ɓa raak rim, ɓum ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay (30), ɓum ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino (60), ɓinooɓi teemet (100). »
Laampaani
Yeesu woyissa ɓa ne : « Laampa na ɓayse ne wa kunu na kanoh wala wa ɗaaku ŋ ooɓ fiƴaangi e ? Wa na degse ŋ degohaaniŋ wa kay !
In nu ɗembɗu ɗah, wa ɗembɗu ne mbeh hey haye, wa teeɓohu. In nu ɗasɗu ɗah, wa ɗasɗu ne mbeh hey haye, wa teeɓohu noh cong.
Ɓo' nu raak nof kerhoha ɗah, a kerhaat. »
A woyissa ɓa ne : « Markissaat baahiɗ ini ɗu na kerhe ! Inhaat ne, ɓeesohaani ɗu na ɓeesɗohohe, weɗ ɗu ɓeesɗohsan, ƴut ɗah, ɗu ɓaatu.
Laam ɓoyi raak hey ɓaatse, waaye ɓoyi raakɗi, ini ƴissuuti a amb sah hey naafse nga ɗe. »
Tisoh ci
Yeesu woyissa ɓa ne : « Nguuriŋ-Kooh mand na inii : A nikee ɓo', a sokka tisoh ŋ yohon.
Ƴutta, a taalndiɗta, wek reesa ɗah a neehe, noh ɗah a kuruk. Tisoha paarra po wa yakka te a inahɗi findi wa kaɗoh po wa hennda ɗaa.
A merhey mi ŋ haf wa paariɗa, wa raakka pok, wa ɓiɗissa, wa marakka ;
wa ruunnda rek, a inahha ne nguɗ reyiɗ, a ɓayya japil, a nguɗtaa. »
Tisohiŋ mutardaani
Yeesu woyissa ne : « Ɓoo min mandtiɗkoh Nguuriŋ-Kooh na ye ? Ɓoo mina teeɓoh na winde andiin ?
Wa mand na kuɓu mutarda, wa sokuusa ɗah, weɗ na uupe ƴissuut ŋ tisoh ciŋ kidig ci ƴin ci na sokse ŋ nguuk jen,
waaye wa sokuusa po wa paarra ɗah, wa yak po wa uup ca, wa raak naak yakak po sel ci min taar ŋ saangniŋ wa. »
Yeesu jangɗohohee ɓa ɗaa, ŋ andiin laayiɗ findi andiin cii, a jangɗeeɗa ɓa in hend na ini haf ciŋ ɓa min amb.
A woyeeɗi na ɓa ŋ ini nikɗi andiin, waaye a ɗaayya na taalubeeciŋ ɗe ɗah, a toksiɗ ɓa ca jen.
Yeesu yeeɓkiɗiɗ cookma
Mbaɗi, wa noha muy, Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne : « Ɓoo kaɗaat ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ cookma. »
Ɓa faɗta mboolnda ndaam, taalubeeciŋ ɗe ɓayya ɗe na gaala a nikohe, ɓi gaal wiiriis hunnda na ɓa.
Ɗekka po pahul yakak kurukka, ginaah ca laɓkeeɗa ŋ gaala po wa riifiɗta na masuɓ.
Raak Yeesu neeheeɗa ŋ lecmaŋ gaala, a ooɓpa tiknukoha ŋ hafiŋ ɗe ; taalubeeciŋ ɗe yunnda ɗe, woosa ɗe ne : « Jangɗohohi, sooƴi ɓoo na sooƴe wii, tumɗi ɗa in e ? »
Wa a yunu, a ngassa puuɗsa, a woosa cookma ne : « Yeeɓka ! Seema ! » Puuɗsa seemmba, ɗiska eennda teɗ.
Ƴutta a woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne : « Wa ye tah ɗu neek ? Ɗu ris kosɗi poyi e ? »
Ɓa feyuusa lool, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne : « Ƴaarii joy nik ɓa po puuɗsi na cookmi sah kerhiɗee ɗe ? »
